احتبيت (form VIII)
# اِحْتَبَيْتُ (iḥtabaytu) /iħ.ta.baj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِحْتَبَى (iḥtabā)
# اِحْتَبَيْتَ (iḥtabayta) /iħ.ta.baj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْتَبَى (iḥtabā)
# اِحْتَبَيْتِ (iḥtabayti) /iħ.ta.baj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْتَبَى (iḥtabā)
# اُحْتُبِيتُ (uḥtubītu) /uħ.tu.biː.tu/: first-person singular
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
